en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2851 - Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) saying:

I asked him about a woman performing Sa'i (running between Safa and Marwah) on a mount or a camel.
Imam (as) said: "There is no problem with that."

I also asked him about a man doing the same,
Imam (as) said: "There is no problem with it, but walking is better."
